violations.why: Jasper ISR (priority 1) can pre‑empt the low‑priority task between the two reads of v_meadow, writing a new value and causing the task to see inconsistent data.
Nimbus ISR (priority 2) becomes enabled after Jasper runs and can pre‑empt the task between the two reads of v_meadow, overwriting it and leading to a read‑write‑read race.
Nimbus ISR may execute after the first comparison (line 34) but before the second (line 37), writing v_falcon and causing the two comparisons to be based on different values.
